maya.activity: Wake up, stretch, and read the news in bed before getting dressed.
maya.intention: Start the day quietly and check transportation news before work.

maya.activity: Make coffee and a quick breakfast, then pack lunch and fill a water bottle.
maya.intention: Eat before meetings and avoid having to improvise lunch later.

maya.activity: Get dressed and set up the glass desk for remote work.
maya.intention: Put on comfortable work clothes and make the desk usable before the first meeting.

maya.activity: Work from home at the glass desk, attending planning meetings and reviewing maps.
maya.intention: Keep the morning work block focused and document unresolved items as they arise.

maya.activity: Eat the packed lunch at the kitchen counter and make tea.
maya.intention: Take a real break before the afternoon work block.

maya.activity: Prepare the queen bedroom for the visiting relative and make a short hosting checklist.
maya.intention: Make the room welcoming without over-organizing it into a hotel.

maya.activity: Continue remote work and write project notes at the glass desk.
maya.intention: Finish the main notes before the household becomes more social.

maya.activity: Review the day’s work, close the laptop, and clear the desk into its usual arrangement.
maya.intention: Create a clean stopping point so hosting does not get mixed up with unfinished work.

maya.activity: Change clothes, put work items away, and make tea before the visit.
maya.intention: Decompress briefly and shift from work mode into hosting mode.

maya.activity: Set out a simple welcome drink and check the guest room and shared areas.
maya.intention: Make the relative feel expected without fussing over every surface.

maya.activity: Welcome and spend time with the visiting relative, keeping conversation easy while dinner is prepared.
maya.intention: Be present and affectionate without managing every pause in the conversation.

maya.activity: Help prepare a simple dinner and eat together at the dining table.
maya.intention: Share an uncomplicated meal that leaves enough energy for conversation.

maya.activity: Clear the dinner things and wipe down the kitchen while keeping the hosting transition calm.
maya.intention: Restore enough order that the evening does not end in a kitchen ambush.

maya.activity: Sit with the relative and Daniel in the living room for a quieter visit.
maya.intention: Let the visitor settle in and give everyone some shared, low-pressure time.

maya.activity: Practice a few piano scales and difficult passages, then put the music back under the paperweight.
maya.intention: Keep a small piece of my normal Tuesday without turning it into a performance.

maya.activity: Read fiction and prepare clothes for tomorrow in the bedroom.
maya.intention: Wind down and make tomorrow morning predictable.

maya.activity: Put my phone on charge, place my reading glasses in the nightstand drawer, and go to sleep.
maya.intention: Finish the day gently and protect the remaining quiet time.

daniel.activity: Wake up, brush my teeth, wash, and shower while listening to a podcast from my phone.
daniel.intention: Start the day and wake up gradually.

daniel.activity: Grind coffee beans by hand, boil water, and make coffee while finishing the podcast.
daniel.intention: Make coffee before breakfast and get settled into the morning.

daniel.activity: Make and eat breakfast at the kitchen counter while talking with Maya before work.
daniel.intention: Have breakfast together before our separate workdays begin.

daniel.activity: Edit dialogue, attend remote production calls, and monitor audio from the work setup.
daniel.intention: Complete the morning edit and handle the production calls carefully.

daniel.activity: Make a quick lunch and eat it standing at the kitchen counter.
daniel.intention: Eat efficiently without losing too much work time.

daniel.activity: Continue editing and monitoring audio, joining a remote studio session if needed.
daniel.intention: Finish the afternoon audio work and deliver the most urgent revisions.

daniel.activity: Stop work, pack the laptop and cables, and clear the most visible parts of the queen bedroom so Maya’s relative can use it comfortably.
daniel.intention: Switch from work mode to hosting mode and make the guest space welcoming.

daniel.activity: Carry my phone to the bar cart, drink water, and check what ingredients need using first before starting dinner.
daniel.intention: Take a short reset and organize the evening around the visitor’s arrival.

daniel.activity: Cook an improvised dinner using ingredients that need to be used first, tasting as I go and making room for the visiting relative at the table.
daniel.intention: Help make the evening feel relaxed and inclusive rather than overly formal.

daniel.activity: Finish dinner, eat at the dining table with Maya and the visiting relative, and keep conversation moving so nobody feels left out.
daniel.intention: Be an attentive host while giving Maya some support.

daniel.activity: Spend relaxed time with Maya and the visiting relative in the living room instead of doing my usual private headphone session; offer drinks and answer questions about the house.
daniel.intention: Make the visitor feel included while keeping the atmosphere easygoing.

daniel.activity: Wash up and settle the kitchen, leaving tasting spoons on the sink side while I clear the most visible cooking items.
daniel.intention: Keep hosting clutter from spreading through the house.

daniel.activity: Wind down quietly, drink water, and get ready for bed while checking that the guest arrangements are comfortable.
daniel.intention: End the day gently and preserve a little private time with Maya.

daniel.activity: Get into bed and fall asleep.
